category_title: Students who freeze and avoid participation during public academic tasks to prevent peer ridicule
minimal_context: The student is working on a worksheet during a regular education classroom activity.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Please continue with the classroom activities and finish the next question on your worksheet.

STUDENT: It is kind of hard to ask for help... cause sometimes I think I just know it but I cannot get it.

TUTOR: Just keep trying to figure it out.

STUDENT: I do not understand the question... I will be trying to get it, but I do not know it sometimes... everybody must be getting it, but I do not know it.

TUTOR: What do you think the answer is?

STUDENT: (Becomes more quiet and reserved, not actively participating) Sometimes I forget again and... I do not want to ask again. I do not want to say something silly.

options.A: Use psychometric assessments to set individual targets and provide frequent acknowledgment of achievements during regular classroom activities.
options.B: Require participation in specialized training programs, such as the Triple E Program, BEST in CLASS, and the Behavior Expectation Discrepancy Tool.
options.C: Teach mindfulness principles and exercises, use poems for reflection, and assign homework involving technique practice and journaling.
options.D: Foster an optimal classroom environment characterized by supportive teacher-student relationships and problem-solving, as well as a lack of conflict and disruptions.
